summary: Iteration 4 verifies the new Trading Rules Engine (leverage, liquidation, auto-tick, circuit-breaker/resume, 2:1 reward:risk, backtest). Backend: 9/10 tests PASS, 1 SKIPPED (test_auto_position_has_2to1_reward_risk skipped because no auto position was opened in this run — simulated market signals did not consistently produce a BUY score>=62 in 5 ticks; 2:1 math is enforced in code at trading.py:107 `tp = round(sl*2, 2)` and is separately visible via portfolio when an auto position does open). Backend confirmed: admin login OK; POST /api/trading/manual with usd_amount=10 leverage=20 returns leverage=20, warning string, position.notional=200, position.usd_amount=10 (margin), and cash decreases by only $10 (margin) not $200 (notional); manual leverage capped at 50 when 999 sent; no warning when leverage<10; SELL close returns valid pnl and pnl>=-margin (liquidation floor); auto_tick response contains equity/drawdown_pct/halt; concurrent auto positions never exceeded 2; GET /api/trading/auto/status returns risk_halt/halt_reason/consecutive_losses/peak_equity; POST /api/trading/auto/resume clears risk_halt & consecutive_losses; GET /api/trading/backtest?symbol=BTC&interval=1h returns 5 windows with win_rate/return_pct + overall stats + disclaimer, no crash; owner commission code path still fires on profitable close (regression via reports endpoint). Frontend e2e (public preview URL, admin login): ManualTrade shows data-testid=manual-leverage-input slider (1-50); leverage-warning appears at 15x and hides at 5x; AutoTrade page (route /auto-trade) renders rules-badges with all 6 expected rule strings ('2:1', 'Max 2 concurrent', '10x', 'Manual ≤ 50x', '20% drawdown', '5 losses', 'Scans all coins & timeframes'); halt-banner hidden while not halted; auto-trade-toggle-button toggles state and fires ticks.

minor.issue: In simulated-market conditions, 5 consecutive ticks did not always produce an opened auto position (score>=62 threshold + BUY-only filter); this is expected but makes deterministic testing of the 2:1 TP/SL persistence flaky. Consider a test seam or a debug endpoint.
Sign-up rate limiter (429 'Too many sign-ups from this network. Try later.') triggers quickly during test runs. Not a bug — but tests must reuse admin/existing users.

issues: Panel subtitle still reads 'The bot scans 1h BUY signals…' but the new engine scans 15m/1h/4h across ALL coins. Update copy for accuracy.

action_items: Update AutoTrade.jsx Panel description string from '1h BUY signals' to reflect multi-timeframe scanning (15m/1h/4h all coins).
Optional: add an integration-test seam that lets tests force a specific coin/timeframe signal so the 2:1 TP:SL invariant can be deterministically asserted.
critical_code_review_comments: trading.py _open_position: notional=usd*leverage, margin deducted = usd (correct); leverage clamped to >=1 and (via caller) capped at auto/manual max — good.

trading.py _close_position: pnl = max(pnl_raw, -margin) correctly implements liquidation floor. proceeds = margin+pnl-commission ensures user cannot lose more than margin. consecutive_losses is reset on win (pnl>0) and incremented on non-win — note: pnl==0 (rare with floats) will count as a loss; acceptable.

trading.py auto_tick: scans COINS x [15m,1h,4h], picks single best BUY score>=62, respects held-symbol dedupe and max_concurrent_auto=2 (default from settings). Auto leverage capped by min(settings.auto_leverage, 10.0) — enforced hard-cap of 10 ✓.

trading.py auto_tick: drawdown_pct computed on equity=cash+holdings vs peak_equity; when dd>=drawdown_halt_pct it closes ALL open positions with reason 'drawdown_halt' and sets risk_halt=True + auto_trade=False in settings. Good.
trading.py backtest: entry gate 'sig.action==BUY & score>=64 & sma_fast>sma_slow' (trend filter), fixed SL=3% / TP=6% (strict 2:1). Uses candle low/high to detect stop/target intra-bar — correct.
trading.py manual_trade: leverage = min(input, settings.manual_max_leverage default 50), warning when lev>=10 — matches PRD.
AutoTrade.jsx: description text is outdated (see design_issues). Rules-badges bar is a nice always-visible reminder; halt-banner + resume-button flow is clean.
ManualTrade.jsx: warning shown at lev>=10 in the UI, matches backend threshold. Slider range 1..50 matches manual cap. Good.
seed_data_creation: Admin's demo state was reset via /api/trading/demo/reset and /api/trading/auto/resume at the start of the module for a clean run; multiple manual + auto trades were then opened/closed on admin's account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Four backend test files under /app/backend/tests/: backend_test.py (28 general regression), test_security_iter2.py (7 security), test_owner_iter3.py (17 owner/commission/withdraw), test_rules_iter4.py (10 rules-engine/leverage/auto-tick/backtest). Run all: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v -o addopts=''` (pytest.ini enables xdist which fails on env-var read — use -o addopts='' to disable). NOTE: /api/auth/register rate-limits aggressively (~5/network) — reuse admin account via /api/trading/demo/reset + /api/trading/auto/resume between tests instead of creating fresh users. AutoTrade route is `/auto-trade` (NOT /autotrade). Slider updates must go through React's nativeInputValueSetter to trigger controlled-input change (documented in the test script). The single skipped test (`test_auto_position_has_2to1_reward_risk`) will PASS whenever the simulated market produces a qualifying BUY signal in 5 ticks — retry-friendly. 2:1 TP:SL invariant is enforced in code at trading.py:107 regardless.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs. The only cosmetic miss is AutoTrade.jsx line 117 subtitle mentioning '1h BUY signals' instead of multi-timeframe scanning; this is user-facing copy drift, not a functional bug.
